candidate_definitions.draft_text: DRAFT - NOT APPROVED. The date on which cash and securities are exchanged to complete a trade. (Reproduced from GL-101 v1.0; not reconciled with the conflicting GL-204 definition, which requires Data Steward resolution.)
cited_clauses: GL-101 v1.0 (verbatim): "The date on which cash and securities are exchanged to complete a trade."
paraphrased_or_added_clauses: Added: the parenthetical note that the text is unreconciled with GL-204 and requires Data Steward resolution. This is agent commentary, not source content.

No clause from GL-204 ("contractual date by which payment and delivery ... must complete, as agreed at execution") has been merged in; choosing between an actual-exchange date and a contractual-due date is a human decision.

conflicts_identified: GL-101 (Settlement Date, v1.0, Approved, owner Avery Example (SYNTHETIC)) defines it as the date cash and securities are actually exchanged; GL-204 (Settlement Date, v2.1, Approved, owner Blake Example (SYNTHETIC)) defines it as the contractual date by which payment and delivery must complete, as agreed at execution. Both are Approved with different owners and a recorded possible_duplicate link; the two meanings (actual versus contractual) are not clearly equivalent. Neither was picked as authoritative.
